arxiv-2003-12044.title: Real-Time Video Content Popularity Detection Based on Mean Change Point Analysis
arxiv-2003-12044.creator: Sotiris Skaperas, Lefteris Mamatas, and Arsenia Chorti
arxiv-2003-12044.description: Abstract Video content is responsible for more than 70 % 70\% of the global IP traffic. Consequently, it is important for content delivery infrastructures to rapidly detect and respond to changes in content popularity dynamics. In this paper, we propose the employment of on-line change point (CP) analysis to implement real-time, autonomous and low-complexity video content popularity detection.

arxiv-2012-03798.title: Optimal Insurance to Minimize the Probability of Ruin: Inverse Survival Function Formulation
arxiv-2012-03798.creator: Bahman Angoshtari, Virginia R. Young
arxiv-2012-03798.description: Abstract We find the optimal indemnity to minimize the probability of ruin when premium is calculated according to the distortion premium principle with a proportional risk load, and admissible indemnities are such that both the indemnity and retention are non-decreasing functions of the underlying loss.

arxiv-2108-08702.title: Finite-temperature linear response theory based on relativistic Hartree Bogoliubov model with point-coupling interaction
arxiv-2108-08702.creator: A. Ravlić, Y.F. Niu, T. Nikšić, N. Paar, P. Ring
arxiv-2108-08702.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by A. Ravlić, Y.F. Niu, T. Nikšić, N. Paar, P. Ring. The finite-temperature linear response theory based on the finite-temperature relativistic Hartree-Bogoliubov (FT-RHB) model is developed in the charge-exchange channel to study the temperature evolution of spin-isospin excitations. Calculations are performed self-consistently with relativistic point-coupling interactions DD-PC1 and DD-PCX. In the charge-exchange channel, the pairing interaction can be split into isovector ( T = 1 T=1 ) and isoscalar ( T = 0 T=0 ) parts.

arxiv-2207-04041.title: Double Field Theory with matter and the generalized Bergshoeff-de Roo identification
arxiv-2207-04041.creator: Eric Lescano, Nahuel Mirón-Granese
arxiv-2207-04041.description: Abstract The scalar field-perfect fluid (sf-pf) correspondence shows that the energy-momentum tensor of a scalar field is in correspondence with the dynamics of a perfect fluid. In this work we generalize this concept to study the higher-derivative structure of Double Field Theory with statistical matter.

arxiv-2210-09464.title: Preliminary Model for Operational Effectiveness Assessment of Dismounted Combat Teams
arxiv-2210-09464.creator: Graham V. Weinberg
arxiv-2210-09464.description: Abstract This paper is concerned with introducing a framework in which the operational effectiveness of a dismounted combat team can be assessed. It has been motivated by studies at Defence Science and Technology Group which have focused on the structure of the future dismounted fighting force.

arxiv-2302-01006.title: Continuous Images of Closed Sets in Generalized Baire Spaces Thanks: The authors would like to thank the referee for the careful reading of the manuscript.
arxiv-2302-01006.creator: Philipp Lücke, Philipp Schlicht
arxiv-2302-01006.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Philipp Lücke, Philipp Schlicht. Let κ \kappa be an uncountable cardinal with κ = κ < κ \kappa=\kappa^{{<}\kappa} . Given a cardinal μ \mu , we equip the set μ κ {}^{\kappa}\mu consisting of all functions from κ \kappa to μ \mu with the topology whose basic open sets consist of all extensions of partial functions of cardinality less than κ \kappa .

arxiv-2406-00738.title: Global Rewards in Restless Multi-Armed Bandits
arxiv-2406-00738.creator: Naveen Raman, Zheyuan Ryan Shi, Fei Fang
arxiv-2406-00738.description: Abstract Restless multi-armed bandits ( rmab ) extend multi-armed bandits so pulling an arm impacts future states. Despite the success of rmab s, a key limiting assumption is the separability of rewards into a sum across arms. We address this deficiency by proposing restless-multi-armed bandit with global rewards ( rmab-g ), a generalization of rmab s to global non-separable rewards.

arxiv-2409-09950.title: Detecting meV-Scale Dark Matter via Coherent Scattering with an Asymmetric Torsion Balance
arxiv-2409-09950.creator: Pengshun Luo, Shigeki Matsumoto, Jie Sheng, Chuan-Yang Xing, Lin Zhu, Zhi-Jie Zhuge
arxiv-2409-09950.description: Abstract Dark matter with mass in the crossover range between wave dark matter and particle dark matter, around ( 10 − 3 , 10 3 ) (10^{-3},\,10^{3}) eV, remains relatively unexplored by terrestrial experiments. In this mass regime, dark matter scatters coherently with macroscopic objects.

arxiv-2502-13595.title: MMTEB: Massive Multilingual Text Embedding Benchmark
arxiv-2502-13595.creator: Kenneth Enevoldsen, Isaac Chung, Imene Kerboua, Márton Kardos, Ashwin Mathur, David Stap, Jay Gala, Wissam Siblini, Dominik Krzemiński, Genta Indra Winata, Saba Sturua, Saiteja Utpala, Mathieu Ciancone, Marion Schaeffer, Gabriel Sequeira, Diganta Misra, Shreeya Dhakal, Jonathan Rystrøm, Roman Soloma
arxiv-2502-13595.description: Abstract Text embeddings are typically evaluated on a limited set of tasks, which are constrained by language, domain, and task diversity. To address these limitations and provide a more comprehensive evaluation, we introduce the Massive Multilingual Text Embedding Benchmark (MMTEB) – a large-scale, community-driven expansion of MTEB, covering over 500 quality-controlled evaluation tasks across 250+ languages.

arxiv-2510-16939.title: Cavitation onset in transient pressure fields
arxiv-2510-16939.creator: Pierre Coulombel, Fabian Denner
arxiv-2510-16939.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Pierre Coulombel, Fabian Denner. While it is well known that cavitation occurs in liquids under tension, no universally accepted criterion for its onset in transient pressure fields exists. We propose a precise definition of the critical tension for cavitation in transient pressure fields that bridges the gap between quasi-static and dynamic regimes, identifying cavitation as the transition of the bubble radius to a dynamically unstable state.

pmc-10640824.creator: Yan Lu, Wei Gou, Hai Feng Zhang, Yi Ying Li
pmc-10640824.description: BackgroundPatients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and cirrhosis often have impaired fasting glucose (IFG). This study sought to investigate the impact of liver fibrosis on islet function in individuals diagnosed with CHB and IFG.Material and MethodsPatients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and impaired fasting glucose (IFG) were selected for this study.

pmc-10836254.title: Impact of different ANCA serotypes on the long-term outcome of ANCA-associated vasculitis patients
pmc-10836254.creator: Fumin Qi, Jian Hao, Wei Wei
pmc-10836254.description: ObjectivesTo investigate the clinical features and long-term outcomes of Chinese anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies (ANCAs)-associated vasculitis (AAV) patients with different ANCA serotypes.MethodsTwo hundred and twenty-four AAV patients from January 2010 to June 2021 were divided into myeloperoxidase (MPO)-ANCA and proteinase 3 (PR3)-ANCA groups. Clinical and long-term outcomes were compared.ResultsIn this study, the average follow-up was 46.4 months (range 0.3–188.4 months).

pmc-11476192.title: Carpal Tunnel Syndrome in Elite Female Tug-of-War Athletes: Prevalence and Risk Factor Analysis
pmc-11476192.creator: Chiang-Hui Huang, Kuo-Cheng Liu, Ju-Wen Cheng, Shao-Chih Hsu, Chih-Kuang Chen
pmc-11476192.description: Background: Tug-of-War (TOW) games involve repetitive hand movements and vigorous force, raising the risk of peripheral neuropathy in the upper extremities. The prevalence of carpal tunnel syndrome (CTS) in TOW athletes remains unclear. We hypothesize that elite female TOW athletes have a higher prevalence of CTS than the general population.

pmc-11543146.title: Renal failure after surgical mitral valve interventions: a meta-analytical approach
pmc-11543146.creator: Hasaan Ahmed, Mahmoud Ismayl, Anirudh Palicherla, Ruth Ann Mathew Kalathil, Jalal Dufani, Amjad Kabach, Ahmed Aboeata
pmc-11543146.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). udden cardiac death being feared complications. While an array of procedural modalities exist in treating mitral valve disease, surgical intervention remains the gold standard, encompassing either mitral valve repair (MVr) or replacement (MVR). Renal failure is a feared complication among those undergoing cardiac surgery, associated with profound morbidity and mortality, with data on the incidence of renal failure after surgical mitral valve interventions remaining limited2.

pmc-11554836.title: The role of IGF1 in determining body composition in children and adolescents with growth hormone deficiency and those with idiopathic short stature
pmc-11554836.creator: Hussein Zaitoon, Michal Yackobovitch-Gavan, Eyas Midlej, Adi Uretzky, Irina Laurian, Anna Dorfman, Hagar Interator, Yael Lebenthal, Avivit Brener
pmc-11554836.description: PurposeTreatment with recombinant human growth hormone (rhGH) increases insulin growth factor-1 (IGF1) levels, therefore, monitoring both IGF1 and growth constitutes an acceptable parameter of therapeutic safety and efficacy. We aimed to investigate the relationship between IGF1 level and body composition in children and adolescents undergoing rhGH therapy for growth hormone deficiency (GHD) and idiopathic short stature (ISS).

pmc-12586577.title: Accurate AQI forecasting in a high-altitude city using a simulated CVOCA-BiLSTM hybrid model: a case study of Lhasa, Tibet
pmc-12586577.creator: Fangjing Xiao, Xiaomei Cui, Guibin Jiang, Duo Bu, Qiangying Zhang
pmc-12586577.description: Forecasting of the Air Quality Index (AQI) in high-altitude cities is significantly challenged by nonlinear temporal dynamics, particularly due to complex interactions between atmospheric physics and pollutant transport. A hybrid forecasting model integrating a simulated Complex-Valued Optical Convolution Accelerator (CVOCA) with a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network is presented to improve prediction accuracy and computational efficiency.

pmc-12847894.title: Systemic engineering and global regulation enabling high-level bilirubin biosynthesis
pmc-12847894.creator: Zhentao Jiang, Jingxin Rao, Caokai Zhu, Yamiao Li, Qiang Zhu, Mingyue Zheng, Wenchi Zhang, Rongzhen Zhang
pmc-12847894.description: Bilirubin biosynthesis has long been constrained by low yields and poorly understood bottlenecks. Here, we report a fully in vitro pathway that converts heme to bilirubin with the titer of 1.7 g/L and 95.8%. Systematically, enzyme screening and mechanistic analysis reveal the hidden challenge: Fe²⁺-induced oxidative degradation of intermediates.

pmc-13445664.creator: Xiaoying Chen, Yuan Yue, Jun Xiang, Fang Zhang
pmc-13445664.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). As a key indicator in sports psychology reflecting athletes’ complex physiological and psychological responses to challenges or threats, athlete burnout has become a focal issue in research on athlete-coach interactions and athletic performance.Objective To investigate the impact of coaches’ leadership behaviors on athlete burnout among Chinese collegiate student-athletes and to validate the mediating roles of psychological resilience and emotion regulation in this relationship.Method Using convenience sampling combined with cluster sampling, 519 student athletes from multiple Chinese universities were selected as participants.

pmc-13481408.title: Cultural Adaptation and Preliminary Assessment of the Italian Version of the FICA© Spiritual History Tool in the context of End-Of-Life Cancer Patients
pmc-13481408.creator: Andrea Bovero, Arianna Scomazzon, Irene Di Girolamo, Chiara Lamannis, Christina Puchalski, Mario Cagna, Francesca Cotardo
pmc-13481408.description: Spirituality is widely recognized to play an important role in the experience of terminally ill cancer patients, and several studies have shown that spiritual dimensions in their care can significantly enhance their quality of life and emotional well-being. The FICA© Spiritual History Tool, developed by Dr. Christina Puchalski, provides clinicians with a framework for addressing patients’ spiritual histories.

pmc-13572823.description: Unraveling the regulation of electrode local geometric curvature on bubble dynamics is essential to mitigate mass transport losses for the oxygen evolution reaction (OER). Here we identify local electrode curvature as a physically grounded descriptor.
